# Working of Brute Force Method

#### Course: DSA with C++

## Working of Brute Force Method

To find the required pattern, we align the pattern with the same length at the beginning of the text.

![Aligning the Pattern With Same Length of Text](data:image/png;base64,)

We then compare the first characters of the text and the given pattern.

![Comparing the First Characters of the Text and the Pattern](data:image/png;base64,)

As "C" and "C" match, we now check for the other characters.

![Comparing the Remaining Characters](data:image/png;base64,)

Here, the first four characters of the pattern match with the original text. In other words, we found a match.

However, the text can have more than one occurrence of the pattern. Thus, we continue our search.
